description: This file contains the main authorization and authentication functions for the TestLink project, including user login, session management, LDAP and OAuth integration, SSL client certificate handling, and related user validation routines.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the system, with methods for database operations, password comparison, and session management.

methods.name: doAuthorize
methods.description: Performs user authentication by verifying login credentials, handling OAuth, LDAP, or automatic user creation, and managing user sessions.

methods.name: doSSOClientCertificate
methods.description: Handles SSL client certificate-based single sign-on by verifying user existence and setting session cookies.

methods.name: auth_does_password_match
methods.description: Checks if the provided password matches the stored credentials using LDAP, MD5, or database methods based on the user’s authentication type.

methods.name: getUserFieldsFromLDAP
methods.description: Retrieves user details like email, first name, last name from LDAP server based on username and LDAP configuration.

methods.name: doSSOWebServerVar
methods.description: Performs SSO login based on web server environment variables, establishing user session if credentials match.

methods.name: doSessionSetUp
methods.description: Initializes user session, sets session cookies, and prevents multiple simultaneous sessions for the same user.
